description: Itemised multi-wall link budgets computed with sim/twin/mwm.py (docs/MODEL.md §2-6) for unit-testing other implementations. Positions are in metres (x east, y north, z up). rss_dbm = tx_dbm + gain_tx_dbi + gain_rx_dbi - pl_db; pl_db = pl0_db + pl_distance_db + sum(walls.loss_db) + sum(slabs.loss_db); d_m is the clamped distance max(|R-T|, 0.5). Client-source links (tx = c1) give PL(X, c) with no antenna gain and rss_dbm = null. margin_m = smallest distance of the link to any model decision boundary (all >= 0.05 m for the random links). t/u/s_m/zc are the crossing parameters of §2.1 (a wall counts only for 1e-5 < t < 1 - 1e-5). attack_checks_baseline: §6 with nested tiers (deauth and evil twin also require eavesdropping): margin_*_db = min(raw margin, margin_eavesdrop_db); feasible when margin >= 0.
